bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new emergency shelter and other municipal improvements in the city of Hilltop; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+HILLTOP; EMERGENCY SHELTER AND MUNICIPAL IMPROVEMENTS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+$3,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the city of Hilltop for site preparation and to construct, furnish, and equip a new tornado and emergency shelter. This appropriation may also be used to construct, furnish, and equip space for city administration offices, council chambers, a community room, and a playground for city residents and the Hilltop Mobile Home Community. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $3,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a new emergency shelter and other municipal improvements in the city of Hilltop; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. HILLTOP; EMERGENCY SHELTER AND MUNICIPAL IMPROVEMENTS.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$3,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the city of Hilltop for site preparation and to construct, furnish, and equip a new tornado and emergency shelter. This appropriation may also be used to construct, furnish, and equip space for city administration offices, council chambers, a community room, and a playground for city residents and the Hilltop Mobile Home Community.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $3,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: HILLTOP; EMERGENCY SHELTER AND MUNICIPAL IMPROVEMENTS.

$3,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of public safety for a grant to the city of Hilltop for site preparation and to construct, furnish, and equip a new tornado and emergency shelter.  This appropriation may also be used to construct, furnish, and equip space for city administration offices, council chambers, a community room, and a playground for city residents and the Hilltop Mobile Home Community.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $3,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
